style: Use the attached images ONLY as a STYLE reference for the LINE and the flat playful editorial look — match their bold confident black ink outlines, flat colors with NO gradients and minimal shading, and generous negative space. Draw a brand-new, SIMPLE, uncluttered illustration with one clear subject (not a busy scene).
end: Subject centered with lots of empty space around it. Absolutely no text, no words, no letters, no numbers, no captions.
